title: Recombinant Protein Expression of MMLV-RT H+ (SkiBar H+ RT) V2
author: Alex Brown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bijzkcp6

steps.title: Prepare Starter Plate
steps.instruction: Streak Rosetta DE3 from frozen stock onto LB plates supplemented with Carbenicillin (Carb) and Chloramphenicol (Cam).

substeps.instruction: Incubate plate overnight at 37°C.

steps.title: Inoculate Starter Culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 5 mL of LB broth supplemented with Carb and Cam using a single colony from the overnight streak plate.

substeps.instruction: Grow overnight at 37°C with shaking at 250 rpm.

steps.title: Prepare Large Scale Culture
steps.instruction: Prepare 500 mL of LB broth and sterilize by autoclave, allowing it to reach room temperature overnight.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate 500 mL of LB with 1 mL of the starter culture.
Supplement the 500 mL LB broth with Carb and Cam.
Incubate at 37°C in a shaker at 275 RPM.

steps.title: Induce Protein Expression
steps.instruction: Monitor OD 600 every 30-40 mins, increasing frequency to every 5-10 mins as OD 600 approaches 0.5.

substeps.instruction: Induce with 0.5 mM IPTG when OD 600 reaches 0.8-1.0.
Incubate for induction at 18°C for 20-24 hours.

steps.title: Harvest and Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Collect cells by centrifugation at 4,000 x g for 30 min at 4°C.

substeps.instruction: Wash cells once with 1X Lysis Buffer (20 mM Imidazole).
Resuspend pellet in 5 mL of ice-cold 1X Lysis Buffer per gram of wet pellet.
Add lysozyme to a final concentration of 1 mg/mL.
Lyse by sonication in salted ice water using 15 cycles of 10 seconds on and 30 seconds off (continue until suspension is translucent, avoiding frothing).
Centrifuge for 30 min at 18,000 rpm at 4°C.

steps.title: Fractionate Proteins
steps.instruction: Separate the soluble proteins (supernatant) from the insoluble/inclusion body proteins (pellet).

substeps.instruction: Keep 40 µL of supernatant for SDS-PAGE (soluble proteins).
Resuspend the pellet in 5 mL column buffer and keep 40 µL for SDS-PAGE (insoluble proteins/unlysed cells).
Use the supernatant for the subsequent purification step.

steps.title: Ni-Sepharose Purification
steps.instruction: Perform the following steps at 4°C using 0.5 mL of Ni Sepharose Fast Flow beads equilibrated with 1X Lysis Buffer (20 mM Imidazole).

substeps.instruction: Load clarified lysate onto the column.
Collect flow-through and re-load it onto the column a second time.
Wash the column with 10 column volumes of Buffer C.
Elute with 5 mL of Buffer D (500 mM Imidazole), collecting each 1 mL fraction separately in 1.5 mL tubes.

steps.title: Analyze and Regenerate Column
steps.instruction: Measure protein absorbance of eluted fractions using a Nanodrop, using imidazole-containing elution buffer as the blank reference.

substeps.instruction: Record sample values until absorbance returns to background levels.
Regenerate the column with 10 mL washes of water, 1M NaOH, water, 50 mM EDTA, water, 100 mM NiCl, and 20% EtOH.
Store the column in 20% EtOH in the fridge.

steps.title: Concentrate and Buffer Exchange
steps.instruction: Concentrate the protein using an Amicon filter with a molecular weight cut-off of ~1/3 the target protein (for MMLV 79.8 kDa, use a 25 kDa cutoff) or perform dialysis into 50% glycerol storage buffer.

substeps.instruction: Exchange buffer with storage buffer containing 2x concentration of salts and no glycerol.
Perform the exchange 3 times, spinning at 6,000 g for 30-60 min each time.

steps.title: Final Storage
steps.instruction: Store the protein in a storage buffer containing 50% glycerol.

substeps.instruction: Dilute the 2x salt exchange buffer 50% by adding 100% glycerol.
Create aliquots and store at -20°C.
